children: Huang Licheng, known as “Machi Big Brother,” had his long positions fully liquidated again, bringing his cumulative losses to $36.85 million. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, data cited from Lookonchain on October 18 showed the liquidation occurred four hours earlier.

The 250,000 USDC he deposited two days ago has now been nearly wiped out. A year ago, Huang made $44.84 million trading on Hyperliquid; he has since given back all of those profits and incurred an additional $36.85 million in losses.

title: Machi’s Long Positions Liquidated Again, Cumulative Losses Reach $36.85 Million
